verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Approved. Round 2 confirms the prior review: the 135-minute M3 floor is independently bounded above the measured 91.5-minute maximum and below the retired six-hour threshold, with production behavior exercised immediately around the floor and on worker.yml's real workflow_dispatch baseline key. The policy parser is line-anchored, selects the maximum configured timeout, ignores documented/commented occurrences, and fails closed when no assignment exists. The real-file seam binds the shipped constant to policy/repos.toml and pins the measured policy value; the workflow sparse checkout includes that input, while existing exact-line bidirectional seam checks prevent a checkout-only or REQUIRED_FILES-only change from passing. The assertions use independent literals and tracking inputs, so the derivation, parser, reachability, and boundary claims are non-vacuous. No trust check, permission boundary, token handling, or action pin is weakened.
